prompt: 3 days in Lisbon: what to see and eat

plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A quick guide to spending three days in Lisbon, from hilltop views and old trams to custard tarts and fresh seafood. Save it for your next trip.

beats.narration: Three days in Lisbon, and the whole city fits on seven hills. Start on day one with yellow trams and sunset views.

props.clip_query: yellow tram in old city street
clip_queries: yellow tram in old city street

beats.narration: Day two, wander the old riverside and historic neighborhoods. Stop for a warm custard tart with coffee. Simple, flaky, perfect.
Day three, eat grilled fish by the water, then walk slowly. Lisbon rewards anyone who takes their time.
